limitations: Official publication is evidence of what the publisher reports; retrieval does not establish an independent factual check.
Roster omission is not classified as a vacancy.
Contact details (email, phone, photo) appear only where an official roster publishes them; mailboxes or numbers shared across members are omitted.
No city/town records, secondary-source records, population estimates or population-weighted overlaps.
County and county-equivalent geography does not establish county governing structures or officeholder districts.
